## otakumode.com (Information)

- https://otakumode.com/otapedia/games/final_fantasy/unlimited -- story, episodes, credits, related media -- accessed 2026-10-17
  - (fetched by me, text pasted by user; Tokyo Otaku Mode's Otapedia, sections Characters, Plot, Reception, Related Media)
  - an animated Japanese television series of 25 episodes first aired in 2001, directed by Mahiro Maeda, written by Atsuhiro Tomioka, with music by Akifumi Tada and Shiro Hamaguchi
  - the twins Ai and Yu Hayakawa (12 years old) travel to the parallel world of Wonderland looking for their missing parents, first by Ghost Train, then with the Comodeen rebels on the submarine Jane and the airship Silvia, against Earl Tyrant
  - agrees with the entry's description (the twins, Wonderland, their parents, 25 episodes)
  - the later turns are spoilers and not copied
  - its intro once writes the twin's name as Yui, a slip
  - it also ranks the series #18 of 20 on the Anihabara list for November 2001 (a reception note outside our scope)
  - **its Related Media section names the related works, all of which are entries in this group**: Sou no Kizuna (Twin Bonds), Unlimited Before (called a CD drama), the serial web novel After Spiral, the 2002 book Gakai no Sho (in Unlimited After), the radio drama After 2 (broadcast on December 26, 2002 by Avex), the games Unlimited with U and Unlimited on PC Adventure - Labyrinth (checked 2026-10-17)
